y-m-52-04.title: Kana tisingazivi k, inosangana ne x-axis kangani?
y-m-52-04.topic: Kusangana kwegraph ye quadratic function ne x-axis
y-m-52-04.goal: Zvionere kuti kutonga nezve huwandu hwemapoinzi ekusangana e quadratic function ne x-axis kunodzikira sei painowedzera ruzivo, uye utaure zviitiko zvese zvinogoneka kunyange kana mutengo mumwe usingazivikanwi.
y-m-52-04.material: Pane parabola y = x² − 4x + k (k i constant). Ruzivo nezve k runoratidzwa rumwe pachimwe. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza zvaunogona kutaura nezve huwandu hwemapoinzi apo parabola iyi inosangana ne x-axis (verenga poinzi apo inongobata sa 1 poinzi).
y-m-52-04.thinking.0: Kufunga zviitiko zvese zvinogoneka kana ruzivo rwashaikwa
y-m-52-04.thinking.1: Kudzikisa kana kuchinja kutonga neruzivo rutsva
y-m-52-04.thinking.2: Kuwana mitengo yakati wandei inoenderana nemamiriro
y-m-52-04.prereq.1: Ma graphs e quadratic functions (vertex, kuvhurika kumusoro), nehukama pakati pe real roots ye quadratic equation nemapoinzi apo graph inosangana ne x-axis
y-m-52-04.s.s1.hint.0: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, tsanangura mumashoko kuti vertex ye parabola iri kupi (pamusoro kana pasi pe x-axis).
y-m-52-04.s.s1.hint.1: Isa ma integers madiki mashoma pa k uye uronge huwandu hwemapoinzi ekusangana mutebhura.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Hauzivi k, asi unoziva chete kuti k i positive (k>0).
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Tinogona kutaura chii nezve huwandu hwemapoinzi apo parabola iyi inosangana ne x-axis?
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Sezvo y=(x−2)²+k−4, vertex i (2, k−4). Kana 0<k<4 vertex i pasi pe x-axis, saka pane mapoinzi 2; kana k=4 inobata x-axis, saka poinzi 1; kana k>4 i pamusoro pe x-axis, saka mapoinzi 0. Kana pane mutengo usingazivikanwi, unofanira kufunga zviitiko zvese zvinogoneka.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Sezvo k i positive, vertex i pamusoro pe x-axis, saka nguva dzose pane mapoinzi ekusangana 0
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Nyora zvakananga y-coordinate ye vertex nema k. 'k i positive' hakufanani ne 'y-coordinate ye vertex i positive.'
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Parabola inovhurika kumusoro inogara iine mapoinzi 2
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kunyange kana inovhurika kumusoro, kana parabola ichifamba zvakazara pamusoro pe x-axis, haisangani nayo. Funga nzvimbo ye vertex.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Zvichienderana nemutengo we k, mapoinzi 0, 1, ne 2 zvose zvinogoneka
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uku i kutonga kunofunga zviitiko zvinogoneka nekufungidzira y-coordinate ye vertex ichifamba kumusoro nepasi ne k.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: 0 kana 2 chete zvinogoneka, uye hapana k inopa 1 chaizvo
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Poinzi 1 inoitika kana vertex iri pa x-axis. Tarisa kana k yakadaro iri pakati pe positive numbers.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Chokwadi chitsva: y-coordinate ye vertex ye parabola iyi i 0 kana kushoma.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kana ikabatanidzwa neruzivo rwe k>0, tinogona kutaura chii nezve huwandu hwemapoinzi ekusangana?
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana k−4≤0 uye k>0, saka 0<k≤4. Kana 0<k<4, pane mapoinzi maviri akasiyana, uye kana k=4, inobata papoinzi imwe. Saka mapoinzi 0 haagoneke, asi hatisati taziva kana i 1 kana 2. Kutonga kwekutanga ('zvose zvinogoneka') hakuna kuipa; ruzivo painowedzera, zviitiko zvinogoneka zvakadzikira.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: I 1 kana 2 zvichienderana nekuti k i 4 here, uye inosangana nepoinzi imwe zvishoma
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uku i kutonga kunoparadzanisa chiitiko apo y-coordinate ye vertex i 0 nechiitiko apo i shoma kupfuura 0.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Pasinei nenzvimbo ye vertex, mapoinzi 0, 1, ne 2 achiri kugoneka zvose
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Nyora zvakare kuti mamiriro ekuti y-coordinate k−4 ye vertex i 0 kana kushoma akadzikisa sei range ye k inogoneka.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kana tisingazivi kana k i 4 chaizvo, hatigone kusarudza kana i 1 kana 2, asi haisi 0
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uku i kutonga kunoparadzanisa zvisingagone kusarudzwa nezvinogona kusarudzwa.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Sezvo vertex i pasi pe x-axis, nguva dzose inosarudzwa kuti i 2
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Tarisa kana chiitiko apo y-coordinate ye vertex i 0 chaizvo chakasanganisirwa mumamiriro.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Unodzidzawo kuti k i integer. (integer k ne 0<k≤4)
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mitengo mingani ye k inoita kuti ma x-coordinates emapoinzi ese apo inosangana ne x-axis ave ma integers?
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana k=1, x=2±√3, uye kana k=2, x=2±√2, izvo zvisiri ma integers. Kana k=3, x=1, 3, uye kana k=4, x=2 (poinzi yekubata), zvose i ma integers, saka mhinduro i 2. Zvichienderana nekuti chiitiko chekubata chinoverengwa semapoinzi ekusangana here, mhinduro inogona kuverengwa se 1, saka pakutanga takabvuma 'itore sepoinzi 1 yekusangana.'
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Chiitiko chekubata (poinzi 1 yekusangana) i poinzi yekusangana zvakare. Tarisa kumashure kana wakatarisa kuti x-coordinate muchiitiko ichocho i integer.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uku i kutonga kunoenzanisa mhedzisiro yekuisa mitengo ina ye k nenhevedzano uye kuwana ma x-coordinates emapoinzi ekusangana.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wana zvakananga ma x-coordinates emapoinzi ekusangana kune k=1 ne 2.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wana zvakananga ma x-coordinates emapoinzi apo inosangana ne x-axis kana k=1 uye utarise kana i ma integers.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga wakatonga 'zvose zvinogoneka,' asi ruzivo painowedzera zvakadzikira kuita 'haisi 0' ne '2 chete se candidate.' Kuchinja kwekutonga kwako kwakasiyana sei nekutonga kwako kwekutanga kuri kwakaipa? Dai wakasarudza nhamba imwe neruzivo rushoma zvikuru, ungadai wakakanganisa kupi?
y-m-52-04.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino, hapana mamiriro ekuti k i positive; chete kuti k i integer. Wana mitengo 3 yakasiyana ye k apo parabola inosangana ne x-axis pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana uye dhuri pakati pemapoinzi maviri iwayo i integer.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza k imwe uye uwane ma x-coordinates emapoinzi maviri ekusangana.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora dhuri pakati pemapoinzi maviri ekusangana nema k, uye utarise kuti k inofanira kuva nechimiro chipi kuti mutengo uyu ive integer.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Kune k iyi haisangani pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana. Tarisa kana vertex i pasi pe x-axis.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Dhuri pakati pemapoinzi maviri ekusangana i integer.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Dhuri pakati pemapoinzi maviri ekusangana haisi integer. Wana ma x-coordinates emapoinzi maviri ekusangana uye utarise musiyano wawo.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.explain: Ma x-coordinates emapoinzi maviri ekusangana i 2±√(4−k), saka dhuri i 2√(4−k). Kana 4−k i perfect square (1, 4, 9, 16, ...), dhuri i integer, uye k = 3, 0, −5, −12, −21, ...

y-m-52-01.title: Mhedzisiro yakafanana here kana tikachinja nhevedzano?
y-m-52-01.goal: Dzidza kuti kuwana mhedzisiro imwe chete kune chinopinda chimwe chete hakusi humbowo hwokuti 'nguva dzose yakafanana,' uye ramba chirevo nokutsvaga zvinopinda umo nhevedzano inochinja mhedzisiro.
y-m-52-01.material:
Pane michina miviri yokuverenga. Muchina f unowanza chinopinda kaviri uye unowedzera 1 (f(x)=2x+1), uye muchina g unoita chinopinda sikweya (g(x)=x²). Chinopinda chinogona kuva nhamba chaiyo ipi neipi.
Kana ukavabatanidza se 'f wobva g,' mhedzisiro ndi g(f(x)); kana ukavabatanidza se 'g wobva f,' mhedzisiro ndi f(g(x)). Minseo akati, “Kumichina miviri ipi neipi, mhedzisiro yakafanana kunyange nhevedzano ichichinjwa. Inoshandawo kumichina yedu kana ndikaisa 0. f wobva g: f(0)=1, g(1)=1. g wobva f: g(0)=0, f(0)=1.”
y-m-52-01.thinking.0: Tonga kana muenzaniso mumwe wakakwana kuparadzanisa
y-m-52-01.thinking.2: Paradzanisa zvinopinda zvakakosha umo zvirevo zviviri zvinongoenzana
y-m-52-01.prereq.0: H3 mubasa iri inongova nhanho yokuoma yokugoverwa kwokugadzirwa; kurikulamu haipi giredhi racho. Inofungidzira vadzidzi vakatodzidza yuniti yemabasa eCommon Mathematics yechikoro chepamusoro.
y-m-52-01.prereq.1: Chirevo chebasa rakabatanidzwa f(g(x)) nokutsvaga kukosha kwaro (yuniti yemabasa)
y-m-52-01.s.s1.prompt: Minseo akatarisa kuti nhevedzano dzose mbiri dzinopa 1 kuchinopinda 0. Tinogona kutaura chii kubva pakutarisa uku?
y-m-52-01.s.s1.hint.0: Gadzira tafura inoverenga nhevedzano mbiri zvakasiyana, uye uyedze zvinopinda 0, 1, ne -1.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga patafura kunyange sero imwe umo mhedzisiro mbiri dzakasiyana.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.a: Dzakafanana pa 0, asi hatizivi kana dzakafananawo kuzvimwe zvinopinda. Tinofanira kuchinja chinopinda uye tiverenge zvakasiyana.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.a: Uku kutonga kunoziva kuti mhedzisiro yechinopinda chimwe inotiudza chete nezvechinopinda ichocho, uye kunoedza kusarudza zvimwe zvinopinda zvokuyedza.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.b: Kubatanidza kunochinjana sokuwanza, saka kwakafanana kunyange nhevedzano ichichinjwa, uye kuenzana pa 0 ndiko humbowo
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.b: Zvakasiyana nokuwanza, kuchinja nhevedzano yebasa rakabatanidzwa kazhinji kunochinja mhedzisiro. Tarisa kana kuenzana pa 0 kuchishanda sehumbowo, uye kana dzakafananawo kuzvimwe zvinopinda.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.c: Kana tikaisa zvimwe zvinopinda zvishoma uye zvose zvikabuda zvakafanana, tinogona kugumisa kuti dzinogara dzakafanana
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.c: Kunyange kana ukatarisa zvimwe zvinopinda zvishoma, hauna kutarisa nhamba chaiyo dzose. Kuti ugumise kuti dzakafanana unofanira kuenzanisa zvirevo, uye kusiyana kunogona kuratidzwa nomuenzaniso mumwe unopikisa.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.d: Mhedzisiro dzokutanga dzenhevedzano mbiri dzakasiyana, f(0)=1 ne g(0)=0, saka mhedzisiro dzokupedzisira dzinogara dzakasiyanawo.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.d: Kunyange mhedzisiro dzedanho rekutanga dzichisiyana, mhedzisiro dzokupedzisira dzinogona kuva dzakafanana. Pa 0, mhedzisiro dzokupedzisira dzenhevedzano mbiri dzose dzaiva 1.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.explain: Kuenzana pachinopinda chimwe kunoreva kuti dzinoenzana pachinopinda ichocho chete. Kuti utarise kana kuputsa 'nguva dzose,' unofanira kuyedza zvimwe zvinopinda.
y-m-52-01.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga zvinopinda 3 zvakasiyana x zvinoputsa chirevo chaMinseo. (Mhedzisiro mbiri g(f(x)) ne f(g(x)) dzinofanira kusiyana. Unogona kushandisa nhamba chaiyo x ipi neipi.)
y-m-52-01.s.s2.hint.0: Isa g kukosha kwaunowana nokutanga kuisa f pachinopinda x, wobva wachinja nhevedzano uye uverenge zvakare.
y-m-52-01.s.s2.hint.1: Yedza nhamba dzizere dziri padhuze ne 0 rimwe panguva imwe uye uenzanise kana kukosha kuviri kwakaenzana.
y-m-52-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Kuchinopinda ichi mhedzisiro dzenhevedzano mbiri dzakafanana. Sarudza chimwe chinopinda uye uverengezve nhevedzano dzose mbiri.
y-m-52-01.s.s2.explain: g(f(x))=(2x+1)²=4x²+4x+1 ne f(g(x))=2x²+1. Semuenzaniso, kuna x=1 ndi 9 ne 3, uye kuna x=2 ndi 25 ne 9, dzakasiyana. Musiyano wezvirevo zviviri ndi 2x²+4x=2x(x+2), saka zvinopinda chete umo dzakaenzana ndi x=0 ne x=-2; chero chimwe chinopinda muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-52-01.s.s3.prompt: Ungati chii kuna Minseo? Pa muenzaniso unopikisa unoratidza nenhamba kuti chirevo chakanganisa, uye uwedzere shoko pamusoro pezvinopinda umo nhevedzano mbiri dzakapa mhedzisiro yakafanana (pane zvimwe kunze kwe 0 here?).
y-m-52-01.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza chimwe chezvinopinda zvawakawana pamusoro uye unyore mhedzisiro dzenhevedzano mbiri padivi pedzimwe.
y-m-52-01.s.s3.hint.1: Rongedza patafura kuti zvinopinda zvipi mhedzisiro mbiri dzaiva dzakafanana uye zvipi dzaiva dzakasiyana.
y-m-52-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga here uye wakanyora mhedzisiro dzose mbiri dzenhevedzano dzechinopinda chawakasarudza?
y-m-52-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here kuti 'yakafanana pa 0' ne 'inogara yakafanana' zvirevo zvakasiyana?
y-m-52-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakatarisa here kana paine zvimwe zvinopinda umo dzakaenzana usati wanyora?

y-m-52-02.title: Magirafu maviri anosangana kupi?
y-m-52-02.goal: Ramba, nomuenzaniso unopikisa, kuparadzanisa kwakanganisa kwokuti chokwadi chokuti 'girafu yebasa inverse yakaenzana padivi nepadivi pa y=x' chinoreva kuti 'mapoinzi okusangana awo ari pa y=x zvakare,' uye utaure mamiriro umo mienzaniso inopikisa inoitika.
y-m-52-02.material:
Kana basa f rine basa inverse f⁻¹, magirafu maviri akaenzana padivi nepadivi pomutsetse y=x. Jiho akati, “Saka mapoinzi apo magirafu e f ne f⁻¹ anosangana anogara ari pamutsetse y=x. Semuenzaniso, kana f(x)=2x−3, saka f⁻¹(x)=(x+3)/2 uye magirafu maviri anosangana pa (3,3), saka zvakarurama. f(x)=x³ inosanganawo pa (0,0), (1,1), ne (−1,−1).”
(Funga chete mabasa akatsanangurwa kunhamba chaiyo x dzose. Ngatidaidze mutsetse y=x 'axis yokuenzana'.)
y-m-52-02.thinking.2: Gadzirisa chirevo uchishandisa zvinofanana mumienzaniso inopikisa
y-m-52-02.prereq.1: Chirevo chebasa inverse, nechokwadi chokuti magirafu e f ne f⁻¹ akaenzana padivi nepadivi pa y=x
y-m-52-02.prereq.2: Magirafu emabasa emutsetse, kugadzirisa zvirevo zvemutsetse
y-m-52-02.s.s1.prompt: Mabasa maviri akayedzwa naJiho ndi f(x)=2x−3 ne f(x)=x³. Tinogona kutaura chii pamusoro pechirevo chaJiho kubva pamienzaniso miviri iyi chete?
y-m-52-02.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira magirafu emabasa maviri nemashoko uye utsvage chinhu chimwe chavo chakafanana.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.hint.1: Funga muenzaniso mumwe webasa remutsetse risina hunhu hwakafanana uhwu.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.o.a: Mienzaniso yose mbiri inokwira. Hatigoni kusvika pamhedziso tisati tayedza basa rinodzika.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvinoratidza kuti wakatarisa kuti mienzaniso yakayedzwa inogovana hunhu hupi, uye wakaita kusava nechokwadi nenyaya dziri kunze kwayo.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.o.b: Takayedza marudzi maviri akasiyana, basa remutsetse nebasa cubic, saka tatoyedza nyaya dzose
y-m-52-02.s.s1.r.b: Kunyange marudzi ebasa (chimiro chechirevo) akasiyana, magirafu awo anogona kugovana hunhu hwakafanana muchimiro. Enzanisa zvimiro zvemagirafu maviri.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.o.c: Sezvo magirafu akaenzana padivi nepadivi, zvatoratidzwa kuti mapoinzi okusangana anofanira kuva paaxis yokuenzana
y-m-52-02.s.s1.r.c: Kuti utaure kuti mapoinzi okusangana ari kupi, unofanira kufunga zvakasiyana kana ari paaxis yokuenzana kana kwete. Funga kana chokwadi chokuenzana chichisarudzawo nzvimbo yemapoinzi okusangana.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.o.d: Pane mienzaniso 2 chete, saka tinogona kutaura pachokwadi kuti inogara ichishanda. Hapana nyaya yokuyedza zvimwe
y-m-52-02.s.s1.r.d: Pasinei nokuti mienzaniso ingani, kana ukaunganidza chete mienzaniso yerudzi rumwe chete, haivimbisi 'nguva dzose.'
y-m-52-02.s.s1.explain: Mienzaniso yose mbiri magirafu anokwira kurudyi. Jiho haana kuyedza girafu inodzika, saka kutarisa kwake kunofukidza chikamu chenyaya chete.
y-m-52-02.s.s2.prompt: Ngati f(x)=ax+b (a≠0). Wobva wava f⁻¹(x)=(x−b)/a. Tsvaga mienzaniso 3, uchishandisa zvibatanidzwa zvakasiyana zve (a, b, x0), umo magirafu maviri anosangana papoinzi ine x-coordinate x0 asi poinzi iyoyo isiri pamutsetse y=x.
y-m-52-02.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora f⁻¹(x) sechirevo, uye unyore chirevo chinoti kukosha kwe f ne f⁻¹ kwakaenzana papoinzi imwe x0.
y-m-52-02.s.s2.hint.1: Chinja a kuva -2, -1, 1/2, 2, nezvimwewo, uye utarise kana kukosha kuviri kuchienzana papoinzi imwe chete.
y-m-52-02.s.s2.hint.2: Kana ukaunganidza mienzaniso yako mitatu, tarisa kana a kana b dzinogara dziri kukosha kumwe chete.
y-m-52-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Pa x=x0 kukosha kwe f ne f⁻¹ kwakaenzana (magirafu maviri anosangana).
y-m-52-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Pa x=x0, f(x0) ne f⁻¹(x0) zvakasiyana nomumwe nomumwe. Verenga f⁻¹(x0)=(x0−b)/a zvakananga uye uzvienzanise.
y-m-52-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Poinzi iyoyo yokusangana haisi pa y=x.
y-m-52-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Poinzi iyoyo iri pa y=x. Tarisa kana y-coordinate f(x0) yepoinzi yokusangana yakasiyana na x0.
y-m-52-02.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana f(x)=−x+3, saka f⁻¹(x)=3−x=f(x). Magirafu maviri anopindirana zvizere, saka poinzi se (0,3), isiri pa y=x, ipoinzi yokusangana zvakare. Kuderedza mamiriro c2 kunopa (a+1)((a−1)x0+b)=0, uye kana chinhu chechipiri chiri 0 saka f(x0)=x0, saka poinzi iri pa y=x; saka poinzi yokusangana iri kunze kwa y=x inoitika chete kana a=−1.

y-m-52-03.title: Ma asymptote neintercept zvakanyorwa naHarin: tinogona kuvavimba kusvika papi?

y-m-52-03.material: Kuti adzidze pamusoro pegirafu yebasa rational y=(2x+1)/(x−1), Harin akagadzirisa sezvazvakanyorwa pazasi. Akanyora kuti ma asymptote ndi x=1 ne y=2, uye akawanawo poinzi apo girafu iyi inosangana neaxis ye y. (Funga nhamba chaiyo x ine x≠1.)

y-m-52-03.s.s1.line.2: Ma asymptote ndi x = 1 ne y = 2.
y-m-52-03.s.s1.line.3: Kuisa x = 0 kunopa y = 2 + 1/(0−1) = 1, saka y-intercept ndi 1.
y-m-52-03.s.s1.line.4: Girafu iri kumusoro kurudyi nokuruboshwe kwapasi kwenzvimbo ina dzakaparadzanwa nema asymptote maviri.

y-m-52-05.title: Mhinduro yaDoyun yakabuda munzira kupi?
y-m-52-05.topic: Minimum ye quadratic function pa interval, ne parameter
y-m-52-05.goal: Dzidza kuti fungidziro yekuti 'minimum ye quadratic function pa interval inoitika pa vertex' inogona kusashanda, wobva wapatsanura kuita zviitiko kuwana mutengo we parameter uye utarise kuti mutengo unogutsa fungidziro.
y-m-52-05.material:
Doyun akagadzirisa dambudziko rinotevera. (a i constant, uye x i real number ne 0 ≤ x ≤ 3)
Dambudziko: Wana mutengo we a kuti minimum ye f(x) = x² − 2ax pa 0 ≤ x ≤ 3 ive −12.
Mhinduro yaDoyun i iri pazasi.

y-m-52-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe mumhinduro yaDoyun une kutonga kwakaipa. (Pangava nemitsetse yakawanda.)
y-m-52-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa nenhamba kana x-coordinate a ye vertex i mukati kana kunze kwe interval [0, 3].
y-m-52-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kana a=2√3, verenga mitengo ye f(0) ne f(3) uye uienzanise ne −12.
y-m-52-05.s.s1.line.0: f(x) = x² − 2ax = (x − a)² − a², saka vertex i (a, −a²).
y-m-52-05.s.s1.line.1: Minimum pa interval 0 ≤ x ≤ 3 i −12, saka −a² = −12 inofanira kushanda.
y-m-52-05.s.s1.line.2: Kubva ku a² = 12, a = 2√3 kana a = −2√3.
y-m-52-05.s.s1.line.3: Naizvozvo mitengo ye a inogutsa mamiriro i 2√3 ne −2√3.
y-m-52-05.s.s1.explain: Mumutsetse 2, zvakafungidzirwa kuti minimum inoitika pa vertex, asi izvi zvakarurama kana x-coordinate a ye vertex i pakati pe 0 ne 3 zvichisanganisirwa chete. Mumutsetse 4, hapana kutarisa kuti a yawanikwa inogutsa fungidziro iyoyo. 2√3≈3.46 ne −2√3≈−3.46 zvose i kunze kwe interval [0,3].
y-m-52-05.s.s2.prompt: Tinoda kugadzirisa mhinduro yaDoyun. Kana a=5, minimum ye f(x)=x²−10x pa interval 0 ≤ x ≤ 3 i chii?

y-m-52-05.s.s2.r.a: Uyu i mutengo waunowana nekusiya term ye x² uye kuverenga −10x chete. Verenga f(3) zvakare kubva pakutanga.
y-m-52-05.s.s2.r.b: Izvi zvakashandisa mutengo we vertex −a² sezvawo. Tanga watarisa kana x-coordinate 5 ye vertex i mukati me interval.
y-m-52-05.s.s2.r.c: Uku i kutonga kwakawana poinzi iri mukati me interval apo mutengo i mudiki zvikuru uye kwakawana mutengo we f ipapo.
y-m-52-05.s.s2.r.d: Uyu i mutengo pa x=0. Enzanisa kuti kumuganhu upi wemaviri e interval kunopa mutengo mudiki.
y-m-52-05.s.s2.explain: Kana a=5, x-coordinate 5 ye vertex i kunze kwe interval. Mukati me interval f inoramba ichidzikira, saka minimum i pa x=3 uye f(3)=9−30=−21.
y-m-52-05.s.s3.prompt: Ikozvino wana a yakarurama uye uiise. (A apo minimum ye f(x)=x²−2ax pa interval 0 ≤ x ≤ 3 i −12 chaizvo. Nyora ma fractions se ma decimals.)

y-m-52-05.s.s3.hint.1: Muchiitiko chimwe nechimwe wana a inoita kuti minimum ive −12, wobva watarisa kana a iyoyo ichigutsa mamiriro echiitiko.

y-m-52-06.title: Curve nemutsetse zvinosangana kangani?
y-m-52-06.topic: Huwandu hwekusangana kwegraph ye irrational function nemutsetse
y-m-52-06.goal: Dzidza kuti huwandu hwekusangana kwe irrational function nemutsetse hahugone kusarudzwa ne discriminant ye quadratic equation oga, uye uwane iwe pachako range ye k apo pane kusangana 2 chaizvo nekufunga domain nerange yemitengo (x+k−1≥0).
y-m-52-06.material:
Graph ye irrational function y = √(x+2) + 1 i curve inotanga papoinzi (−2, 1) uye inokwira kurudyi kumusoro, ichichinja zvishoma nezvishoma (x ≥ −2). Tinoda kuwana huwandu hwekusangana nemutsetse y = x + k.
Daeun akaigadzirisa saizvi. “Ita ma expressions maviri akaenzana kuti uwane √(x+2) = x + k − 1, wobva waita square mativi ese kuwana x² + (2k−3)x + (k−1)² − 2 = 0. Discriminant ye quadratic equation iyi i 13 − 4k, saka kana k < 13/4 pane real roots mbiri dzakasiyana, izvo zvinoreva kusangana kuviri.”
y-m-52-06.thinking.1: Kutarisa kana mhinduro dzakawanikwa dzinogutsa expression yekutanga
y-m-52-06.thinking.2: Kugadzira mitengo yakati wandei inoenderana nemamiriro
y-m-52-06.prereq.1: Graph ye irrational function y=√(x+p)+q (domain, poinzi yekutanga)
y-m-52-06.prereq.2: Ma roots ne discriminant ye quadratic equation, netsika yekutarisa kuti ma roots anogutsa expression yekutanga
y-m-52-06.s.s1.prompt: Kana k=0, quadratic equation yaDaeun i x² − 3x − 1 = 0, uye ma roots ayo maviri i anenge 3.30 ne −0.30. Isa ma roots maviri mu expression yekutanga √(x+2) = x − 1. Kutonga kwako nezvemhedziso yaDaeun (kusangana kuviri) i kupi?
y-m-52-06.s.s1.hint.0: Isa rimwe nerimwe pama roots maviri mu √(x+2) ne x−1 uye unyore mitengo miviri padivi pedivi.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana masimbi emitengo miviri akafanana.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.o.a: Hazvina kururama. Pakati pema roots maviri, −0.30 inoita kuti rutivi rwekurudyi rwe expression yekutanga ruve negative, saka haigutsi, uye pane kusangana kumwe chete.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.r.a: Uku i kutonga kwakaisa ma roots mu expression yekutanga uye kwakatarisa kunyange masimbi emativi ese maviri.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.o.b: Zvakarurama. Quadratic equation ine ma roots maviri uye ari mukati me domain x ≥ −2, saka pane kusangana kuviri.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.r.b: Wakatarisa chete kuti ma roots ari mukati me domain. Tarisa zvakare kana masimbi emativi ese e expression yekutanga anoenderanawo.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.o.c: Hazvina kururama. Quadratic equation haina ma roots, saka pane kusangana 0.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.r.c: Equation x²−3x−1=0 ine real roots. Mubvunzo i kuti ma roots iwayo anogutsa expression yekutanga here.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.o.d: Hazvina kururama, asi chikonzero i domain. x = −0.30 i zvakanaka nekuti x ≥ −2, saka root imwe i kukanganisa kwekuverenga.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.r.d: x=−0.30 i mukati me domain. Tsvaga chimwe chikonzero uye uenzanise mhedzisiro dzekuisa mu expression yekutanga.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.explain: √(x+2) i 0 kana kupfuura, saka x−1 inofanirawo kuva 0 kana kupfuura. Kana x=−0.30, saka x−1=−1.30<0, saka haigutsi √(x+2)=x−1 (root yenhema yakaumbwa mukuita square mativi ese). Pa k=0 kusangana chaiko chega i kuya pa x≈3.30.
y-m-52-06.s.s2.prompt: Wana mitengo 3 yakasiyana ye k apo mutsetse y = x + k necurve y = √(x+2) + 1 zvinosangana pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana. (Unogona kuisa ma decimals.)
y-m-52-06.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza mitengo mishoma ye k uye uvhumbure mumashoko chimiro che curve nemutsetse (fungidzira kufambisa mutsetse kumusoro nepasi).
y-m-52-06.s.s2.hint.1: Wana k apo mutsetse unopfuura poinzi yekutanga (−2,1) ye curve.
y-m-52-06.s.s2.hint.2: Verenga uye uenzanise zvakananga huwandu hwekusangana kune k=3 ne k=2.9.
y-m-52-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Kune k iyi huwandu hwekusangana hahusi 2. Funga kana mutsetse uri pamusoro kana pasi pepoinzi yekutanga (−2, 1) ye curve, uye nguva apo unobata curve inouya rini.
y-m-52-06.s.s2.explain: Ngatitii t=√(x+2) (t≥0), mapoinzi apo y=x+k inosangana ne curve y=√(x+2)+1 anoenderana ne roots t≥0 ye k=−t²+t+3, poinzi imwe pa root imwe neimwe. Semuenzaniso, kana k=3 dzinosangana pa (−2,1) ne (−1,2).

y-m-52-08.title: Ma correspondence mangani anoita kuti makosha akwire?
y-m-52-08.topic: Kuverenga functions ne correspondences dzinogutsa mamiriro
y-m-52-08.goal: Gadzira iwe pachako functions dzinogutsa mamiriro 'f(1)<f(2)<f(3)', enzanisa nzira dzakasiyana dzekuaverenga, uye utonge kuti mamiriro anochinja sei huwandu.
y-m-52-08.material: Tinoda kuverenga functions f kubva paseti X={1, 2, 3} kuenda paseti Y={1, 2, 3, 4, 5} dzinogutsa f(1) < f(2) < f(3). (f(1), f(2), ne f(3) imwe neimwe ielement ye Y.)
y-m-52-08.thinking.1: Kugadzira iwe pachako ma correspondence anokodzera mamiriro
y-m-52-08.thinking.2: Kufanofungidzira kuti huwandu hunochinja sei kana mamiriro akaderedzwa
y-m-52-08.prereq.1: Zvinoreva function (element imwe neimwe ye domain inoenderana ne element imwe chete ye codomain)
y-m-52-08.prereq.2: Product rule nepfungwa dzekutanga dze permutations ne combinations
y-m-52-08.s.s1.prompt: Shamwari ina dzakaverenga nenzira dzakasiyana. Sarudza nzira dzose dzinoverenga zvakarurama.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza elements 3 dze Y uye unyore ma f ose aunogona kugadzira nemakosha iwayo.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.hint.1: Tora {1,2,3} semuenzaniso uye uenzanise nzira yaSeoyun nemamiriro f(1)<f(2)<f(3).
y-m-52-08.s.s1.o.a: Hajun: f(1), f(2), ne f(3) imwe neimwe inogona kusarudzwa yakasununguka nenzira 5, saka 5×5×5=125.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.r.a: 125 ihuwandu hunoverenga functions dzose pasina mamiriro. Funga kuti mamiriro f(1)<f(2)<f(3) anodzikisa huwandu hwakadii.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.o.b: Seoyun: f(1) ine nzira 5, f(2) ine nzira 4 pakati pemakosha asara, uye f(3) ine nzira 3 pakati pemakosha asara, saka 5×4×3=60.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.r.b: 5×4×3 ihuwandu hwenzira dzekurongedza 'makosha matatu akasiyana nenhevedzano.' Funga kuti ndeapi mazhinji emarongerwo akasiyana emakosha matatu akafanana anogutsa mamiriro.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.o.c: Jihu: Kana ukasarudza makosha matatu akasiyana, anotarwa se f(1), f(2), f(3) kubva padiki, saka 10.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakafunga kana kusarudza makosha matatu akasiyana kunotara kurongeka kumwe chete kunogutsa mamiriro.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.o.d: Naeun: Pa60 yaSeoyun, pakati pekurongeka 6 kwemakosha matatu akafanana 1 chete ndiyo inokwira, saka 60÷6=10.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakabatanidza huwandu hwekurongeka kwemakosha matatu akasiyana neproportion yeavo anogutsa mamiriro.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.explain: Kana ukasarudza makosha matatu akasiyana {p<q<r}, function imwe inokwira f(1)=p, f(2)=q, f(3)=r inotarwa, uye iyi ndiyo one-to-one correspondence ne functions dzose dzinokwira. Saka 5C3=10. 60 yaSeoyun inoverenga kurongeka kwose kwemakosha matatu akafanana mukurongeka 6, saka unogonawo kuiwana se 60÷6=10.
y-m-52-08.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira functions dzinogutsa mamiriro f(1) < f(2) < f(3) semapeya matatu akarongwa 4 akasiyana (f(1), f(2), f(3)). (a=f(1), b=f(2), c=f(3), dzose ndema integers kubva ku1 kusvika ku5)
y-m-52-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kukosha kudiki kunogoneka kwe f(1), wozonyora nenhevedzano makosha anogona kutorwa ne f(2) ne f(3).
y-m-52-08.s.s2.hint.1: Wedzera murondedzero yako imwe imwe kuti dzirege kufukidzana nemapeya matatu akarongwa awatogadzira.
y-m-52-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota isa makosha ose matatu seema integers.
y-m-52-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Makosha ose matatu ari kubva ku1 kusvika ku5.
y-m-52-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Unogona kushandisa elements dze Y={1, 2, 3, 4, 5} chete.
y-m-52-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Makosha haasi murongerwo unokwira. Sarudza zvakare kuti f(1)<f(2)<f(3).
y-m-52-08.s.s3.prompt: Kana tikachinja mamiriro kuita f(1) ≤ f(2) ≤ f(3), huwandu hwema functions anogutsa huchava hwakawanda kupfuura 10, hushoma, kana hwakafanana? Tsanangura chikonzero nemuenzaniso.
y-m-52-08.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora function imwe inogutsa mamiriro matsva asi isingagutsi mamiriro apfuura.
y-m-52-08.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana functions dzaigutsa mamiriro apfuura dzinogutsawo mamiriro matsva.
y-m-52-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora iwe pachako muenzaniso mumwe kana kupfuura we function itsva inobvumirwa here?
y-m-52-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakati 10 dzekutanga dzose dzichiri musanganisirwa here?
y-m-52-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Kunyange pasina kuverenga huwandu hwakawedzerwa chaizvo, wakatsanangura nemashoko chikonzero nei huchiwedzera here?
y-m-52-08.s.s3.model.0: Huwedzera. Sezvo makosha akaenzana anobvumirwa, senge f(1)=f(2), nyaya nyowani senge (1,1,2) kana (2,2,2) dzinoonekwa, uye 10 dzekutanga dzichiri musanganisirwa.
y-m-52-08.s.s3.model.1: Hunokura. Sezvo makosha anogona kuenzana, (3,3,5) inoshanda uye (4,4,4) inoshandawo. 10 ine f(1)<f(2)<f(3) dzekare dzinogutsawo mamiriro matsva, saka pane dzakawanda kupfuura 10.

y-m-52-09.prereq.0: H3 mubasa iri inongova nhanho yokuoma yokugoverwa kwokugadzirwa; kurikulamu haipi giredhi racho. Inofungidzira vadzidzi vakatodzidza yuniti yemabasa eCommon Mathematics yechikoro chepamusoro.
y-m-52-09.title: Kana ma models maviri achipfuura mapoinzi akafanana, tinofanira kuvimba nepi?
y-m-52-09.topic: Kuenzanisa inverse proportion model ne linear model
y-m-52-09.goal: Tonga, danho nedanho nemiyero mitsva, kuti ndeipi ye models mbiri dzinokodzera mapoinzi maviri yekuvimba nayo, uchifunga nezverenji rinogona kushandiswa nemodel nekukanganisa kwemiyero.
y-m-52-09.material: Kutasva bhasikoro nenzira imwe chete, zvakatora maminetsi 72 pa10 km/h uye maminetsi 48 pa15 km/h. Hazvina kunyorwa kana kutasva kuviri kwaiva panzira imwe chete. Sieun akakurudzira mutsara unopfuura nemapoinzi maviri se model A (nguva = 120 − 4.8×speed), uye Minjae akakurudzira inverse proportion se model B (nguva = 720 ÷ speed). Ma models ose mbiri anokodzera miyero miviri iyi chaizvo. Speed iri mu km/h uye nguva iri muminetsi.
y-m-52-09.prereq.1: Ma graphs nema expressions e linear ne inverse proportion functions, hukama pakati pe speed, distance, nenguva
y-m-52-09.s.s1.prompt: Miyero inowedzerwa imwe panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kuti ndeipi model yekuvimba nayo uye sei.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.hint.0: Isa 20 km, 25 km, ne30 km paawa mu model imwe neimwe uye uenzanise makosha akafanofungidzirwa mutafura.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga musiyano pakati pemakosha akafanofungidzirwa nemakosha akayerwa uye uenzanise ma models maviri.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.info: Data yega yaizikanwa zvino ndiyo miyero miviri (maminetsi 72 pa10 km paawa, maminetsi 48 pa15 km paawa).
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kana ukatasva pa20 km paawa, unotarisira kuti zvichatora maminetsi mangani?
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.after: Model A inofanofungidzira maminetsi 24 pa20 km/h, uye model B inofanofungidzira maminetsi 36. Kana vakatasva nenzira imwe chete, speed×nguva (mushure mekushandura kuma units akafanana) inofanira kuramba yakadaro, saka B inonyanya kuva yakajairika. Asi sezvo zvisati zvatsimbiswa kuti inzira imwe chete, zvinonzwisisikawo kutonga kuti data iyi oga inoita kuti zvive zvakaoma kusarudza.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kufanofungidzira kwema models maviri kwakasiyana, saka hatigoni kusarudza kubva pa data iyi oga. Tinofanira kuyera pa20 km paawa
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uku kutonga kunobvuma kuti data haigoni kutaura kuti ndeipi model yakarurama uye kunosarudza ruzivo rwekutora rinotevera.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Maminetsi 24. Mutsara unopfuura nemapoinzi maviri ndiyo model iri nyore zvikuru, saka tinovimba nemutsara uyu sezvawakaita
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kukodzera mapoinzi maviri hakusi umboo pachako hwekuti mutsara wakarurama. Kana vakatasva nenzira imwe chete, product yenguva ne speed ndeipi?
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Maminetsi 36. Kana vakatasva nenzira imwe chete, speed×nguva inofanira kuramba yakadaro
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakatora hukama pakati pe speed nenguva kubva pafungidziro yekuti nzira yakafanana. Zvisinei, fungidziro iyoyo haisati yatsimbiswa.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Maminetsi 30. Poinzi yepakati pemaminetsi 24 ne36 ine kukanganisa kudiki zvikuru chero divi ripi rakashata
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Avhareji yema models maviri kukosha kusingafanofungidzirwi nemodel ipi neipi. Kukosha kunotarwa nekuti unovimba nemodel ipi.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.info: Kana ukaisa 30 km paawa mu Model A, unowana −24 maminetsi, uye kana ukaisa mu Model B, unowana maminetsi 24.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Pa25 km paawa, nguva ye Model A inova maminetsi 0, uye pamusoro paizvozvo inova negative. Saka A inogona kushandiswa chete murenji apo speed iri 25 kana pasi. B inopa makosha positive kune speed dzose positive, asi izvozvo hazvisi umboo hwekuti B yakarurama, uye zvinofanira kusimbiswa nemiyero mitsva.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.o.a: B iinewo dambudziko rekuti nguva inoswedera ku0 sezvo speed ichikura, saka ma models maviri haakodzeri zvakaenzana
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kunyange speed ikakura sei, nguva ye B inoramba iri positive. Enzanisa kana iri dambudziko rimwe chete ne A, ine nguva inova 0 kana negative.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Nguva negative haigoneki, saka A haigoni kushandiswa kana speed iri pamusoro pe25 km/h. Tinofanira kudzora renji
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakafunga renji umo model inogona kupa makosha enyika chaiyo.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Zvasimbiswa chete kuti A haigoni kushandiswa murenji iri; kuti B yakarurama zvinofanira kusimbiswa nemiyero mitsva
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uku kutonga kunosiyanisa pakati pekuratidzwa kwekukanganisa neimwe model kusimbiswa seyakarurama.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Zvasimbiswa kuti A ine dambudziko, saka zvakatarwa chaizvo kuti inverse proportion model B ndiyo model yakarurama
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kukanganisa kwemodel imwe hakusi umboo hwekuti imwe model yakarurama. Funga kana pane zvikamu zve B zvisati zvaedzwa.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.info: Zvakasimbiswa kuti pa20 km/h nzira yakafanana neyekutasva kuviri kwapfuura yakashandiswa. Kana yakatasvwa chaizvo, yakatora maminetsi 37 (pakanga paine kumirira kumwe chete pa traffic light munzira).
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Uchitarisa muyero, uchaitei nezve Model B?
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.after: Musiyano pakati pekufanofungidzira kwe Model B nemuyero ndi1 miniti, uye kune Model A ndimaminetsi 13. Musiyano mudiki unogona kutsanangurwa nemamiriro ekuyera senge kumirira pa traffic light, saka zvinonzwisisika kuchengeta B. Kunyange zvakadaro, kuyera zvakare pasi pemamiriro akafanana kwaizoita kuti zvive zvechokwadi zvakanyanya.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Musiyano pakati pemaminetsi 36 ne37 mudiki uye unotsanangurwa nekumirira pa traffic light, saka tinochengeta B tichibvumira kukanganisa
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uku kutonga kwakatarisa saizi yemusiyano, kwakafunga chikonzero kunze kwe data (kumirira pa light), uye kwakachengeta model.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.o.b: B yakafanofungidzira maminetsi 36 asi chaizvo kwakanga kuri maminetsi 37, saka ndiyo model yakashata uye tinoirasa tigadzira itsva
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kana ukarasa model nekuti kufanofungidzira nemuyero hazvina kufanana chaizvo, ucharasa angangova ma models ose. Funga nezve saizi nechikonzero chemusiyano.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.o.c: A, ine expression iri nyore, yakakodzera miyero miviri yekutanga chaizvo, saka dzivisa kusaenderana ne maminetsi 37 uye uchengete A
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kufanofungidzira kwe A ndimaminetsi 24, ari maminetsi 13 kubva pakukosha kwakayerwa. Funga kana musiyano mukuru unogona kunyarwa nekuti expression iri nyore.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Musiyano pakati pekufanofungidzira nemuyero mudiki zvikuru kune B (miniti 1 zvichienzaniswa nemaminetsi 13). Chiitiko che traffic light wait chinogona kutarisirwa nekuyera zvakare
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakaenzanisa saizi dzemisiyano nenhamba uye kwakakurudzira muyero wekuwedzera.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga zvakanga zvakaoma kuziva kuti ndeipi model yakarurama, asi sezvo ruzivo rutsva rwakaunganidzwa, renji rinogona kushandiswa ne A rakadzikira uye B yaiva padhuze nemuyero. Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo painowedzerwa, wakasiyanisa sei 'zvakasimbiswa' ne 'zvisati zvasimbiswa'?
y-m-52-09.s.s2.prompt: Kune Model B (nguva = 720 ÷ speed), tsvaga mapeya 3 akasiyana (v, t) umo speed (km paawa) nenguva (maminetsi) zvose zviri ma integers kubva ku5 kusvika ku60.
y-m-52-09.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa kana peya yawatoziva, (15,48), ichigutsa mamiriro, wozogadzira mamwe mapeya nenzira imwe chete.
y-m-52-09.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga wafunga kuti chii chinofanira kuitika kunguva kana ukaita speed kaviri.
y-m-52-09.s.s2.ok.c1: v ne t zvose ndema integers.
y-m-52-09.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota isa speed nenguva seema integers.
y-m-52-09.s.s2.ok.c2: v ne t zvose ndekubva ku5 kusvika ku60.
y-m-52-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Ndapota ita v ne t dziri kubva ku5 kusvika ku60.
y-m-52-09.s.s2.fail.c3: Peya iyi haikodzeri Model B (nguva = 720 ÷ speed). Wedzera v ne t.
y-m-52-09.s.s2.explain: Pakati pemapeya e divisors e720, ayo ane v ne t zvose kubva ku5 kusvika ku60 ndi (12,60), (15,48), (16,45), (18,40), (20,36), (24,30), (30,24), (36,20), (40,18), (45,16), (48,15), (60,12). Kune peya imwe neimwe, v×t=720.
y-m-52-09.s.s2.because.prompt: Verenga product ye speed nenguva kumapeya matatu awakawana, uye unyore zvawakawana mumutsara mumwe.
y-m-52-09.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora kukosha kwe speed kuwedzera nguva kumapeya matatu ega ega.
y-m-52-09.s.s2.because.hint.1: Enzanisa kana ma products ose akafanana.
y-m-52-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga chaizvo ma products emapeya matatu here?
y-m-52-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakabatanidza zvawakawana ne expression ye Model B (nguva=720÷speed) here?
y-m-52-09.s.s2.because.model.0: 12×60=720, 20×36=720, 30×24=720: mumapeya matatu ose, product ye speed nenguva ndi constant 720.
y-m-52-09.s.s2.because.model.1: Ma products ose akanga akafanana, 720. Kana speed ikaita kaviri, nguva inova hafu, saka product inogara yakadaro.

y-m-52-10.prereq.0: H3 mubasa iri inongova nhanho yokuoma yokugoverwa kwokugadzirwa; kurikulamu haipi giredhi racho. Inofungidzira vadzidzi vakatodzidza yuniti yemabasa eCommon Mathematics yechikoro chepamusoro.
y-m-52-10.thinking.2: Kugadzira mitengo yakati wandei inoenderana nemamiriro
y-m-52-10.title: Kana tisingazivi a, pane maximum here?
y-m-52-10.topic: Kuvapo kwe maximum ye quadratic function zvichienderana ne parameter
y-m-52-10.goal: Dzidza kuti rudzi rwe expression runogona kuchinja zvichienderana nekukosha kwe constant isingazivikanwi a, tonga kuti ruzivo rupi rwunodiwa kuti maximum ivepo, uye utsvage iwe pachako a inogutsa mamiriro.
y-m-52-10.material: Pane function f(x) = (a − 1)x² + 4x + 1. a ndi real constant, uye x ndi real number chero ipi. Seunghun akati, “Sezvo iri quadratic function, inofanira kuva ne maximum kana minimum,” uye kukosha kwe a hakusati kwaziva.
y-m-52-10.thinking.1: Kutarisa zvakaparadzana nyaya apo rudzi rwe expression runochinja
y-m-52-10.prereq.1: Maximum ne minimum ye quadratic function (completing the square), coefficient ye quadratic term nechimiro che graph
y-m-52-10.prereq.2: Ma graphs e linear functions (nyaya isina maximum kana minimum)
y-m-52-10.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo rupi rwatingada kuti titonge kana f ine maximum here (pamusoro pe real numbers x dzose)?
y-m-52-10.s.s1.hint.0: Isa makosha senge 0, 1, 2 se a, nyora f(x), uye utsanangure chimiro che graph nemashoko.
y-m-52-10.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga a inoita kuti coefficient ye x² mu expression ive 0.
y-m-52-10.s.s1.o.a: Tinofanira kuziva kana a iri positive kana negative. Chiratidzo chayo chinotara nzira inokombama graph
y-m-52-10.s.s1.r.a: Coefficient ye quadratic term haisi a asi a−1. Nyora zvakare kuti kukosha kupi kunotara kana coefficient iri positive kana negative.
y-m-52-10.s.s1.o.b: Zvatokwana. Sezvo iri quadratic function, inofanira kuva ne maximum
y-m-52-10.s.s1.r.b: Tarisa kana pane a inoita kuti coefficient a−1 ive 0. Function yaizova rudzi rupi mune iyo nyaya?
y-m-52-10.s.s1.o.c: Tinofanira kuziva kuti renji re x rinotanga kupi richisvika kupi
y-m-52-10.s.s1.r.c: Renji re x ratopiwa munyaya (real numbers dzose). Tarisa kuti kukosha kusati kwazikanwa ndekupi.
y-m-52-10.s.s1.o.d: Tinofanira kuziva kana a iri diki kupfuura, yakaenzana ne, kana hombe kupfuura 1
y-m-52-10.s.s1.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakafunga kana chimiro che graph chinoparadzana zvichienderana nechiratidzo che coefficient a−1 ye quadratic term uye kana iri 0.
y-m-52-10.s.s1.explain: Kana a−1<0, ndiyo quadratic function inovhurika nepasi, saka ine maximum; kana a−1>0, inovhurika nepamusoro, saka haina maximum (minimum chete); uye kana a=1, f(x)=4x+1 ndiyo linear function, saka haina maximum kana minimum. Saka tinofanira kuziva kuti a iri kupi zvichienzaniswa ne1.
y-m-52-10.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga makosha 3 akasiyana e a apo f ine maximum uye maximum iyoyo ndi5 kana kupfuura. (Unogona kuisa ma decimals.)
y-m-52-10.s.s2.hint.0: Isa a=0, a=0.5, ne a=−1, tsvaga maximum yega yega, uye uenzanise.
y-m-52-10.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa nemakosha mashoma kuti maximum inochinja sei sezvo a ichiswedera ku1.
y-m-52-10.s.s2.ok.c1: f ndiyo quadratic function inovhurika nepasi (ine maximum).
y-m-52-10.s.s2.fail.c1: Kune a iyi, f haina maximum. Tarisa chiratidzo che coefficient ye x² uye kana iri 0.
